pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal dark regions with relatively sharp edge gradients and minor curvilinear softening at vertices. Patch area is heterogeneous, with larger, more expansive regions on the central flank transitioning to smaller, more elongated geometries towards the neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-colored pathways forming a topological graph characterized by tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes. Pixel thickness of the corridors remains consistent throughout the visible field, providing clear delineation between patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the visible upper neck exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette. The 1D contour consists of fine, dense tufts creating a jagged profile against the sky and background vegetation.
